record.paper_title: Some Open Problems of Ramsey Minimal Graphs
record.original_question: For each integer t ≥ 6, characterize all 2-connected graphs F that are Ramsey (2K₂, tK₂)-minimal; that is, every red-blue coloring of the edges of F contains either a red copy of 2K₂ or a blue copy of tK₂, but for every edge e of F the graph F − e has some red-blue coloring with neither a red copy of 2K₂ nor a blue copy of tK₂.

evidence.quote: say that \(F \rightarrow (G, H)\) if whenever the edges of \(F\) are 2-colored, say with red and blue, there is either a red copy of \(G\) or a blue copy of \(H\). A graph \(F\) is called Ramsey \((G, H)\)-minimal if \(F \rightarrow (G, H)\) but for any edge \(e \in E(F)\), we have \((F - e) \nrightarrow (G, H)\).
More specifically, these problems consider the case where \(G = 2K\_{2}\), the matching on 2 edges.
Problem 1. For each \(t \geq 6\), characterize all 2-connected graphs in \(\mathfrak{R}(2K\_{2}, tK\_{2})\).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For graphs $G$, $H$, and $F$, write $F \to (G,H)$ if for every coloring of the edges of $F$ with the two colors red and blue there is either a red subgraph isomorphic to $G$ or a blue subgraph isomorphic to $H$. A graph $F$ is called Ramsey $(G,H)$-minimal if $F \to (G,H)$ but for every edge $e \in E(F)$ one has $F-e \not\to (G,H)$. Let $kK_2$ denote the matching consisting of $k$ pairwise disjoint edges.

For each integer $t \ge 6$, give an explicit characterization of all $2$-connected graphs $F$ that are Ramsey $(2K_2,\, tK_2)$-minimal.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches reveal partial results on Ramsey $(mK_2, H)$-minimal graphs (e.g., complete characterizations for specific $H$ such as $K_4$, $W_n$, $P_n$, and small matchings), and Burr et al. established that $\mathcal{R}(mK_2, H)$ is finite. However, no source was found giving a complete characterization of all 2-connected graphs in $\mathcal{R}(2K_2, tK_2)$ for general $t \ge 6$, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On Ramsey (mK_2, H)-Minimal Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Ramsey (mK_2, H)-minimal graphs and characterizations for specific H.
status_evidence.claim: Work on related instances exists but the general 2-connected characterization for (2K_2, tK_2) is not stated as resolved.

status_evidence.title: The Complete List of Ramsey (2K2,K4)-Minimal Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Provides characterizations only for the case H = K_4.
status_evidence.claim: Characterizations are available for specific second arguments, not for tK_2 with t >= 6.
